doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 大力振兴装备制造业，是党的十六大提出的一项重要任务
quote_en: Vigorously revitalising equipment manufacturing is an important task set by the 16th Party Congress.
notes: Headline concept; no single SW industry: nearest L1 机械设备 (also spans 电力设备, 国防军工 etc.), L2 none. Minor restriction: 逐步淘汰落后产品及制造技术; 新建和改造工程项目不得进口高能耗、高污染、落后的设备.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 发展大型清洁高效发电装备，包括百万千瓦级核电机组、超超临界火电机组
quote_en: Develop large clean, efficient power-generation equipment, including million-kW nuclear units and ultra-supercritical thermal units.
notes: Also lists 大型水电机组及抽水蓄能机组 and 大功率风力发电机.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 开展1000千伏特高压交流和±800千伏直流输变电成套设备的研制
quote_en: Carry out R&D of complete sets of 1000 kV UHV AC and +/-800 kV DC transmission and transformation equipment.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
concept_zh: 石化及煤化工成套设备
quote_zh: 实现百万吨级大型乙烯成套设备和对二甲苯（PX）、对苯二甲酸（PTA）、聚酯成套设备国产化
quote_en: Localise million-tonne ethylene plant equipment and PX, PTA and polyester plant equipment.
notes: Also 进行大型煤化工成套设备的研制开发. Equipment concept (专用设备), not the chemical industry itself.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 研制大型薄板冷热连轧成套设备及涂镀层加工成套设备
quote_en: Develop large sheet cold/hot continuous rolling and coating plant equipment.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 发展大型煤炭井下综合采掘、提升和洗选设备以及大型露天矿设备
quote_en: Develop large underground coal mining, hoisting and washing equipment and large open-pit mining equipment.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 开发大型海洋石油工程装备、30万吨矿石和原油运输船
quote_en: Develop large offshore oil engineering equipment and 300,000-tonne ore and crude carriers.
notes: Mapping note: civil shipbuilding sits under SW 航海装备Ⅱ (国防军工). Also FPSO, large container ships, LNG carriers, high-power diesel engines.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 使我国轨道交通装备制造业在较短时间内达到世界先进水平
quote_en: Bring China's rail-transit equipment manufacturing to world-leading level in a short time.
notes: Context: 时速200公里以上高速列车、新型地铁车辆.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 发展大气治理、城市及工业污水处理、固体废弃物处理等大型环保装备
quote_en: Develop large environmental equipment for air pollution control, urban and industrial wastewater and solid-waste treatment.
notes: Also 海水淡化、报废汽车处理等资源综合利用设备.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
concept_zh: 大型施工机械（岩石掘进机）
quote_zh: 加快大断面岩石掘进机等大型施工机械的研制
quote_en: Accelerate development of large-section rock tunnel boring machines and other large construction machinery.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
concept_zh: 自动化控制系统与精密测试仪器
concept_en: automation control systems and precision test instruments
quote_zh: 发展重大工程自动化控制系统和关键精密测试仪器
quote_en: Develop automation control systems for major projects and key precision testing instruments.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
concept_en: CNC machine tools and CNC systems
quote_zh: 发展大型、精密、高速数控装备和数控系统及功能部件
quote_en: Develop large, precision, high-speed CNC equipment, CNC systems and functional components.
notes: Aim: reduce dependence on imported high-precision machine tools.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
notes: Context: polyester staple fibre plant, viscose filament spinning machines, cotton spinning sets, rapier and air-jet looms.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 发展新型、大马力农业装备
notes: Aim: reduce reliance on imported tractors above 125 hp.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
concept_zh: 电子专用设备（集成电路、平板显示）
quote_zh: 发展集成电路关键设备、新型平板显示器件生产设备、电子元器件生产设备
quote_en: Develop key IC equipment, new flat-panel display production equipment and electronic component production equipment.
notes: One of a 6-item list under a single verb (intensity 1 by list rule). Flat-panel equipment would map to 专用设备; IC equipment mapped to 半导体.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
concept_zh: 医疗影像及医药生产设备
concept_en: medical imaging and pharmaceutical production equipment
quote_zh: 数字化医疗影像设备、生物工程和医药生产专用设备等，促进装备制造业全面升级
quote_en: Digital medical imaging equipment and bio-engineering and pharmaceutical production equipment, to upgrade equipment manufacturing across the board.
notes: Tail items of the same 6-item list as the electronic equipment row (verb 发展 on the preceding line).

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 发展民用飞机及发动机、机载设备
quote_en: Develop civil aircraft, aero-engines and airborne equipment.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快振兴装备制造业的若干意见（国发〔2006〕8号）（published as 摘要）
quote_zh: 国防科技装备制造业，比照本意见执行
quote_en: Defence-technology equipment manufacturing is to follow this opinion by analogy.
notes: Extends all support measures to defence equipment; L1-wide mapping.
